Script.name: limb init
Script.script: -- Maintained limb.1.2 core. Keep lb[name].hits/t and public methods compatible. lb=lb or {} local keys={'head','torso','left arm','right arm','left leg','right leg'} local aliases={head='head',torso='torso',leftarm='left arm',rightarm='right arm',leftleg='left leg',rightleg='right leg'} function lb.normalizeName(name) name=tostring(name or ''):gsub('^%s+',''):gsub('%s+$',''):lower() if not name:match("^[%a%d_'-]+$") then return nil end return name:sub(1,1):upper()..name:sub(2) end function lb.normalizeLimb(limb) return aliases[tostring(limb or ''):lower():gsub('[%s_]','')] end local function event(name,limb,amount,source) if type(raiseEvent)=='function' then raiseEvent('limb hits updated',name,limb,amount) raiseEvent('yso.limb.sample',name,limb,amount,source) end end function lb.echo(text) if type(cecho)=='function' then cecho('<turquoise>[Limb]: <white>'..text..'\n') end end function lb.initTarget(name) name=lb.normalizeName(name);if not name then return false end lb[name]=lb[name] or {} local row=lb[name];row.hits=row.hits or {};row.t=row.t or {} for _,key in ipairs(keys) do if row.hits[key]==nil then row.hits[key]=0 end end row.meta=row.meta or {source='unverified',calibrated=false,uncertain={},samples=0} -- Historical calibrated=true does not prove that every limb started at zero. row.meta.known=row.meta.known or {};row.meta.uncertain=row.meta.uncertain or {} event(name,'all',nil,'init');return row end local function cancel(id) if id and type(killTimer)=='function' then killTimer(id) end end function lb.addHit(name,limb,amount) name=lb.normalizeName(name);limb=lb.normalizeLimb(limb);amount=tonumber(amount) if not name or not limb or not amount or amount~=amount or amount<0 or amount==math.huge then return false end local row=lb.initTarget(name) row.hits[limb]=row.hits[limb]+amount row.meta.samples=row.meta.samples+1;row.meta.calibrated=true;row.meta.source='game_reported' cancel(row.t[limb]) if type(tempTimer)=='function' then row.t[limb]=tempTimer(180,function() lb.resetLimb(name,limb,'expired') end) end if type(cecho)=='function' then cecho(' <yellow>('..row.hits[limb]..'%)') end event(name,limb,amount,'game_reported');return true end function lb.resetLimb(name,limb,source) name=lb.normalizeName(name);limb=lb.normalizeLimb(limb) local row=name and lb[name] if not row or not limb then return false end row.meta=row.meta or {source='unverified',uncertain={},samples=0} row.meta.known=row.meta.known or {};row.meta.uncertain=row.meta.uncertain or {} source=type(source)=='string' and source or 'manual_reset' row.hits[limb]=0;cancel(row.t[limb]);row.t[limb]=nil if source=='manual_reset' or source=='confirmed_recovery' then row.meta.uncertain[limb]=nil;row.meta.known[limb]=true;row.meta.calibrated=true else row.meta.uncertain[limb]=true end row.meta.source=source event(name,limb,0,source);return true end function lb.confirmRecovery(name,limb) return lb.resetLimb(name,limb,'confirmed_recovery') end function lb.salve(name,area) name=lb.normalizeName(name);local row=name and lb[name] local groups={head={'head'},torso={'torso'},arms={'left arm','right arm'},legs={'left leg','right leg'}} local limbs=groups[tostring(area or ''):lower()] if not row or not limbs then return false end row.meta=row.meta or {source='unverified',uncertain={},samples=0} for _,limb in ipairs(limbs) do row.meta.uncertain[limb]=true end row.meta.source='salve_observed' event(name,tostring(area),nil,'salve_observed') cancel(row.t.cure) if type(tempTimer)=='function' then row.t.cure=tempTimer(3.7,function() row.t.cure=nil for _,limb in ipairs(limbs) do if row.hits[limb]>=100 then lb.resetLimb(name,limb,'salve_estimate');break end end end) end return true end function lb.resetAll(name) name=lb.normalizeName(name);if not name then return false end local row=lb.initTarget(name);cancel(row.t.cure);row.t.cure=nil for _,limb in ipairs(keys) do lb.resetLimb(name,limb,'manual_reset') end return true end function lb.resetCurrentTarget() local resolver=Yso and Yso.get_target local name if type(resolver)=='function' then name=resolver() else name=rawget(_G,'target') end name=lb.normalizeName(name) if not name then lb.echo('Reset failed: no valid current target.');return false end if not lb.resetAll(name) then lb.echo('Reset failed for '..name..'.');return false end lb.echo('Reset '..name..': all six limbs known at 0% (manual baseline).') return true end

Script.script: function lb.prompt() if not lb[lb.normalizeName(target)] then return "" end local ret = {} -- CHANGE ORDER BELOW! CHANGE ORDER BELOW! CHANGE ORDER BELOW! CHANGE ORDER BELOW! CHANGE ORDER BELOW! CHANGE ORDER BELOW! -- for _, v in ipairs({"head", "torso", "left arm", "right arm", "left leg", "right leg"}) do ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- table.insert(ret, ((lb[lb.normalizeName(target)].hits[v] > 100 and "<red>") or ((lb[lb.normalizeName(target)].hits[v] > 0 and "<orange>") or "<grey>")) .. lb[lb.normalizeName(target)].hits[v]) end return "<DimGrey>[" .. table.concat(ret, "<DimGrey>|") .. "<DimGrey>]" end
